decisions.reason: As a 2024 product close to the firm's established water-control business, the flap weir fits existing engineering and application knowledge, and the firm's strong in-house R&D and research links make continued refinement more likely than withdrawal despite its still-early market stage.

The energy management system builds directly on the firm's established digital and infrastructure capabilities and matches its strategic move toward networked, efficient, energy-aware water facilities, so absorptive capacity and strategic fit strongly favor retention.

The overflow flap gate is close to the core offer, was presented prominently as a product line with several models, and in an expanding firm with strong technical knowledge this signals commitment and a low likelihood of near-term discontinuation.
